Our classes are closed on Tuesday, November 10, 2026.

Join us to celebrate Sensei Tom at 6:30 PM. He will get his 4th degree black belt. Josh Griffiths of Clockwork BJJ will award it. Meet us at Iron Guard Dojo, 65 Main St., Pine Bush, NY 12566. Youths are welcome at the 5:00 PM class there.

Private Coaching by Request

Private coaching is one-on-one. It is booked by request, not as a drop-in class.

Ask Sandy about your goals and a time that works. Learn about private lessons or Text Sandy.
